note: v2501: Handing retention_may_act cold to another model family produced four attacks; three refused and one landed - a zero-width space before a valid OFF value armed an unattended irreversible deleter. The switch also armed on offf, disabled and flase, while its own comment three lines above said a typo is not permission. The unrecognised arm was the permissive one. OFF holds, ON proceeds, UNSET still proceeds per his ruling, and a set-but-unrecognised value now holds. My own harness refused my attack and the interlock was moved around rather than widened, which then left the new claim immune to the in-process red proof - it has its own now. prune.arm opened itself at 48/48 with two kinds.
